title: seed: a single-field externalId record whose key value is missing inserts another row on every load, with no warning (sibling of #34857)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaysxGzF62ACvZ1x9x

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding (class b, named producer): the decision analysis for #34857 (area pkg-1 of seat repo:objectstack#5, file `objectstack-seat5/area-ux/pkg-1/decision-34857.md`), measured on `origin/main` `81c09477`. Filed on the seat's word (2026-11-19T05:19Z): stock count first, file if real. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`). Suggested-grade: p2 · same family and grade as #34857 and #34613.
Dedupe: `seed single externalId missing value duplicate`, `externalIdKey empty record inserted every load` in open issues: only #34857 (composite keys, ruled B1).

## 维护者速读

- 现象：种子数据集用单字段 `externalId`（默认 `name`），其中某条记录没填这个字段，其余记录填了。每次加载这条记录都多插一行，没有任何提示。
- 影响：仓库内 26 个种子数据集都不踩（全部键值已填）；只影响作者自写的种子。文档 `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx:313-318` 的示例整组都没有键，那是 #28952 已警告的另一种情况。
- 修法建议：与 #34857 的裁决 B1 同一条规则，延伸到单字段键：加载时拒收这一条并点名对象、记录序号、字段和修法，其余照常。是否沿用 B1 由维护者确认。
- 需要你做的：确认单字段键是否沿用 #34857 的 B1（分诊定级之外）。

## What happens

A seed dataset keyed on one field (`externalId: 'code'`, or the default `name`) where one record has no value for that field (undefined, null or `''`) while other records carry it. `externalIdKey` (`seed-loader.ts:5351`) answers `''` for that record, so it matches no stored row and is inserted again on every load. The #28952 warning (`seed-loader.ts` ~:1803-1811) fires only when EVERY record keys empty, so nothing is said.

Measured with the faithful in-memory engine of `seed-loader-empty-key-warn.test.ts`, three loads of `[{ name: 'A', code: 'a' }, { name: 'B' }]` keyed on `code`: row count 2 → 3 → 4, zero warnings. CONTROL (both records keyed): 2 → 2 → 2.

`seed-loader-empty-key-warn.test.ts:172` ("a dataset where some record carries the key is not warned about") pins the silence for one load; a fix flips it.

## Expected

The same rule Bill ruled for composite keys on #34857 (B1, ruling 7000515976) unless the maintainer says otherwise: at load, the one record with no key value is not written, the load result carries an error naming the object, record index, key field and the fix; other records and datasets load. A deferred reference (authored, resolves empty) is not caught: the check reads the key before references resolve.

## Stock (read 2026-11-19T05:25Z)

26 authored seed datasets (examples/app-showcase 20, app-crm 5, app-todo 1), every one with an explicit `externalId` and every record carrying it: 0 affected. Whitespace-only values are counted as keys (no trim) — not in scope. Hosted / customer stacks not read.

Related: #34857 (composite, ruled B1), #28952 (all-empty warning), #34613 (unkeyed seeds), #34856.
